notices.text: SocialLayer group browse supports event_union federation, so a group can intentionally cross-list partner-group events. ETH-owned entries here come from its self-calendar; federated 4Seas rows keep their actual 4Seas group label.
The official ETHChiangmai group calendar currently contains no event entries. That is an empty source feed, not a fetch error; check the official event list for updates.

verifications.use: Whole-calendar subscription link and source verification only; upcoming agenda entries come from the public events collection.

verifications.interpretation: SocialLayer supports event_union federation. Shared browse rows are expected cross-listing behavior, not proof of an API fault. These rows are not relabelled as ETH-owned events; ETH-owned entries come from self-ICS.

verifications.note: Current season metadata and legacy programme entries coexist; only current season metadata is shown.

At this snapshot, anonymous browser Origin requests received Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; the no-Origin server request lacked ACAO and the response varied by Origin. The Worker remains recommended for field allowlisting, privacy, caching and stale-last-good semantics, not because direct browser CORS is impossible.

programs.curation: Human-reviewed public programme snapshot from official ETHChiangmai, current chiangmai.devfolio.co, and 4Seas Longevity pages. Static only: do not auto-reconcile conflicting official dates.
programs.timezone_policy: Dates without source times remain date-only. Devfolio clock times are preserved as displayed because the extracted source does not state a timezone; never convert them to UTC.
disagreements: Nomad Market II: ETHChiangmai says 25–26 Dec; 4Seas Longevity says 24–25 Dec. Both claims remain below.

Season end: ETH top-level series and SocialLayer say 3 Jan 2027; 4Seas residency says 5 Jan 2027; one current ETH section says 30 Dec. The guide uses Jan 3 for the top-level season without extending it.
Longevity: 29 Nov–29 Dec is a co-living package window; the opening milestone is 30 Nov.
Current hackathon: chiangmai.devfolio.co, not the prior-season ethchiangmai.devfolio.co. Devfolio's displayed clock times have no confirmed timezone.
